svg.title: Early, later, or no payback under the policy

cc:Work.dc:title: Early, later, or no payback under the policy
cc:Work.dc:description: SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL • Three mutually exclusive first-payback states through day 425 Each column sums to 100%, including draws that never pay back under the finite sending policy. These are model-conditional probabilities. 0%/100% draw estimates are not certainty; first payback and horizon positivity are different events.
